about: Chain bytes for the genesis rebuild (token derivation v28), copied verbatim from the 2026-10-21 mainnet and testnet-10 copies (covenant_utxos and covenant_events rows). Each scenario lists transactions in chain order: the events of the covenants the test replays, the cells those covenants spent (outpoint, signature script, input index) and the outputs they created (covenant, index, sompi, script). declarer_rows are the rows the genesis loader reads for the scenario's genesis. seed_vectors are never-spent mainnet TokenSeed outputs with the owner key and class the genesis's own :0 cell revealed.
